'''Garcornia''' was a celestial body<ref name="For the Taking" /> located in the [[Garcornia system/Legends|Garcornia system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Garcornian spice]].<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Garcornian spice]]|system=[[Garcornia system/Legends|Garcornia system]] and specifically Garcornia|legends=1}}</ref> By [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate">{{TORweb|subdomain=forums|url=topic/896545-dear-story-team-what-year-are-we-currently-in/page/5/#comment-9525163|text=Forums: Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], which includes the mission "For the Taking," take place in [[3638 BBY]].</ref> multiple [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing plants]] were situated on Garcornia.<ref name="For the Taking" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TORdate" /> mass riots took place on the celestial body, leaving dozens of the factories in a state of disarray.<ref name="For the Taking" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
During the chaos, an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to acquire any valuable assets from the facilities.<ref name="For the Taking" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Garcornia was introduced in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="For the Taking" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Garcornia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square M-17.<ref name="TEA" />
